about: The low-voltage side: the HLK-PM01 as the 5 V source (mains is not simulated – its nets sit at 0 V), the ESP-12F at its supply requirement, the relay off and on. Values with 'note' are assumptions.

U$1.note: the HLK-PM01's output: 5.0 ± 0.2 V at full load, 600 mA rated (its datasheet, 5.3); 0.1 Ω source resistance assumed

off.about: relay off (GPIO12 low), SEL high: CF1 gives the voltage (GPIO5 low)

on.about: relay on (GPIO12 high), SEL low: CF1 gives the current (GPIO5 high)
